name: menu_irq_on
title: Menu Raster Interrupt On and Off

comments.text: Turns on the interrupts of the menu screen: flash_timer = 20, flash_enable on, then at raster line $e6 raster_split_enable on and the VIC-II raster interrupt on.
Turns off the interrupts of the menu screen: white background, raster_split_enable and flash_enable off, the raster interrupt off, multicolour off.
